verdict.rationale: Docs confirm async job completion webhooks (with override URL) and checkpoint-based multi-step pipelines, supporting non-blocking pipelines; runtime probe confirms the API and SDK/CLI are live. However, no explicit documentation of a status-polling endpoint (e.g., GET job status) or webhook retry/failure semantics, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability at scale. missing for 10: explicit polling/status-check endpoint docs, webhook retry/delivery guarantees, and independent evidence of long-running job behavior under load.
